consent_log_retention_shape.name: consent_log_retention_shape
consent_log_retention_shape.value:
(
        "consent_log"."user_id" is not null
        and "consent_log"."subject_pseudonym" is null
        and "consent_log"."key_version" is null
        and "consent_log"."deleted_account_at" is null
      ) or (
        "consent_log"."user_id" is null
        and "consent_log"."subject_pseudonym" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
        and "consent_log"."key_version" >= 1
        and "consent_log"."deleted_account_at" is not null
      )

exercises_catalog_not_archived.name: exercises_catalog_not_archived
exercises_catalog_not_archived.value: "exercises"."owner_user_id" is not null or "exercises"."archived_at" is null

exercises_catalog_metadata.name: exercises_catalog_metadata
exercises_catalog_metadata.value:
"exercises"."owner_user_id" is not null or (
        "exercises"."slug" is not null
        and "exercises"."movement_pattern" is not null
        and "exercises"."level" is not null
        and cardinality("exercises"."primary_muscles") >= 1
        and "exercises"."default_reps_min" is not null
        and "exercises"."default_reps_max" is not null
        and "exercises"."default_reps_min" between 1 and "exercises"."default_reps_max"
        and "exercises"."default_reps_max" <= 999
        and cardinality("exercises"."substitution_slugs") <= 3
      )

user_profiles_birth_year_range.name: user_profiles_birth_year_range
user_profiles_birth_year_range.value: "user_profiles"."birth_year" is null or "user_profiles"."birth_year" between extract(year from now()) - 100 and extract(year from now())

workout_exercises_reps_range.name: workout_exercises_reps_range
workout_exercises_reps_range.value: "workout_exercises"."reps_min" between 1 and 999 and "workout_exercises"."reps_max" between 1 and 999 and "workout_exercises"."reps_min" <= "workout_exercises"."reps_max"

workout_sessions_finished_consistency.name: workout_sessions_finished_consistency
workout_sessions_finished_consistency.value: ("workout_sessions"."status" = 'completed' and "workout_sessions"."finished_at" is not null) or ("workout_sessions"."status" = 'in_progress' and "workout_sessions"."finished_at" is null)
